L-V0056_Polarized_Sunglasses___Camera_La.pipeline: video-input → reference-image-input → video-analyzer → 4× video-frame-extract → 5× text-gen → 4× image-gen → 4× video-reference → 2× text-gen → video-reference → video-concat → text-gen → video-edit → download

requires.name: Reference video — the film to transfer from

notes: PIPELINE (from the library spec) Ingestion → Video Analyzer extracts shot list: cut timing, film grain / stock emulation, lighting setup, framing, motion vectors, color LUT → Structured Camera Memory (JSON shot-by-shot spec) → Creative Director maps each reference shot onto the polarized sunglasses's own story beats → Nano Banana Pro generates matching first-frame keyframe per shot (product swapped in, composition/lighting matched to source) → Omni Flash 1.1 animates each keyframe using the extracted camera-move + timing spec → Continuity Validator checks product consistency + camera-language fidelity across shots → Repair on drifted shots → Video Concat stitches final sequence → Color grade LUT applied to match reference → Package.
STAGE 1 — INGESTION The reference film plus one photo of the Polarized Sunglasses that will replace its subject.

STAGE 2 — STRUCTURED CAMERA MEMORY Cut timing, camera path, lens, lighting, motion vectors and LUT become a shot-by-shot JSON spec, then each reference shot is mapped onto this product's own story beats.
STAGE 3 — KEYFRAME + MOTION EXECUTION Nano Banana Pro builds the matching first frame per shot with the product swapped in; Omni Flash 1.1 executes the extracted camera move.
STAGE 4 — CONTINUITY VALIDATOR + REPAIR Camera-move trajectory and cut timing compared against the extracted spec; product-lock checked across every shot.
STAGE 5 — CONCAT + LUT GRADE MATCH Shots stitched in order, then a grade pass matches the reference LUT.

notes: PIPELINE (from the library spec) Ingestion → Product + Character Forensics builds locked identity specs → Shot Planner breaks script into 4-6 shots with explicit continuity notes (wardrobe, product state, time-of-day, prop position) → Nano Banana Pro generates each shot's first-frame keyframe conditioned on the SAME locked specs → Omni Flash 1.1 animates each shot → Cross-Shot Continuity Validator checks identity/wardrobe/prop consistency across all shots pairwise → Repair on any drifted shot → Concat with matched cuts → Package.
STAGE 1 — INGESTION Product photo, character reference if the script has one, and the shot script.
STAGE 2 — PRODUCT + CHARACTER FORENSICS Two locked identity specs, both binding on every shot.
STAGE 3 — SHOT PLANNER Breaks the script into 5 shots with explicit continuity notes.
STAGE 4 — KEYFRAMES ON THE SAME LOCKED SPECS + MOTION
STAGE 5 — PAIRWISE CONTINUITY VALIDATOR + REPAIR Identity, wardrobe and prop consistency checked across every pair of shots.

M-VT0009_Canvas_Backpack___Creativity_Re.title: VT0009. Canvas Backpack — Creativity/Resemblance Dial Pipeline (#2)
M-VT0009_Canvas_Backpack___Creativity_Re.summary: INGESTION The existing low-res, flat-lit or off-brand asset — still, footage, or both.
M-VT0009_Canvas_Backpack___Creativity_Re.pipeline: reference-image-input → video-input → 4× text-gen → 3× image-gen → 3× upscaler → video-edit → 3× text-gen → image-gen → download
notes: PIPELINE (from the library spec) Ingestion → Source Forensics assesses resolution, lighting flatness, style gap vs brand target → Enhancement Director configures a Creativity/Resemblance Dial pass, which runs the same source through a range from faithful restoration to aggressive creative reinterpretation, producing a graded set the director can pick from → Nano Banana Pro applies the enhancement to keyframes → Omni Flash 1.1 video-to-video re-renders the full clip carrying the enhancement through every frame with temporal consistency → Fidelity Critic (has identity/branding survived the enhancement, or has it drifted into a different product?) → Repair on drift → Package at delivery resolution (1080p/4K).
STAGE 1 — INGESTION The existing low-res, flat-lit or off-brand asset — still, footage, or both.
STAGE 2 — SOURCE FORENSICS Assesses resolution, lighting flatness and the style gap against the brand target.
STAGE 3 — ENHANCEMENT DIRECTOR Configures the Creativity/Resemblance Dial pass, which runs the same source through a range fro pass. The rule: a better capture of the SAME subject, never a redesign.
STAGE 4 — VIDEO-TO-VIDEO RE-RENDER Omni Flash 1.1 carries the enhancement through every frame with temporal consistency.
STAGE 5 — FIDELITY CRITIC + REPAIR Has identity survived the enhancement, or has it drifted into a different product? Drift triggers a lower-strength re-pass.

notes: PIPELINE (from the library spec) Ingestion → Product Forensics locks product identity → Trend Adaptation Director translates the 'Broadcast Fan-Cam Catch' consumer trend format into a branded commercial application: a telephoto broadcast camera finds the subject in a stadium crowd during a quiet stretch of play; the commentators trail off and the subject reacts to being on the big screen, restaged with the product as the hero or the subject's prized possession → Brand-Fit Filter ensures the adaptation reads as minimal luxury, not as an unrelated meme → Nano Banana Pro generates keyframes with product-lock conditioning → Omni Flash 1.1 animates with native audio → Dual Critic checks (a) trend-format fidelity and (b) product/brand identity consistency → Repair on either failure → Caption/hashtag pairing suggested to file correctly next to the live trend → Package.

STAGE 3 — PRODUCT-LOCKED KEYFRAMES + NATIVE-AUDIO MOTION
STAGE 4 — DUAL CRITIC: TREND FIDELITY + BRAND IDENTITY

M-VT0359_Silk_Scarf___Omni_Flash_1_1__Te.title: VT0359. Silk Scarf — Omni Flash 1.1 'Text-to-Video Concepting' System (#5)
M-VT0359_Silk_Scarf___Omni_Flash_1_1__Te.summary: MODE ROUTER + INPUT PREP Mode: Text-to-Video Concepting.
M-VT0359_Silk_Scarf___Omni_Flash_1_1__Te.pipeline: prompt → reference-image-input → image-input-multi → video-input → 2× text-gen → image-gen → video-gen → video-reference → text-gen → video-edit → 2× text-gen → video-edit → upscaler → download

requires.name: Silk Scarf — anchor image (if the mode uses one)
Source video (if the mode edits one)

notes: PIPELINE (from the library spec) Ingestion → Mode Router selects 'Text-to-Video Concepting': generate directly from a text prompt alone — no image or video input — for rapid concept exploration before committing to a reference-driven build → Input Prep (Nano Banana Pro pre-cleans or generates any needed reference/anchor images) → Omni Flash 1.1 executes the mode's native generation/edit call with correctly structured inputs (frameImages / referenceImages / source video as required) → World-Knowledge Consistency Critic (does the result respect physics, scene logic, and the world-knowledge grounding Omni Flash brings beyond raw photorealism?) → Repair via a follow-up Interactions-API turn (conversational edit) rather than a full regeneration when the mode supports it → Deliver at draft (360p) then promote to 1080p/4K once approved → Package.
STAGE 1 — MODE ROUTER + INPUT PREP Mode: Text-to-Video Concepting. Wire only the inputs this mode actually consumes — text brief, one anchor image, up to five references, or an existing clip.
STAGE 2 — INPUT PREP (NANO BANANA PRO) Pre-cleans or generates any anchor and reference frames the mode requires.
STAGE 3 — OMNI FLASH 1.1 EXECUTION The mode's native call. The text-only lane uses a prompt-only video-gen node; the reference lane conditions on the anchor; the edit lane consumes the source video.

STAGE 4 — WORLD-KNOWLEDGE CONSISTENCY CRITIC Does the result respect physics, scene logic and the world knowledge Omni Flash brings beyond raw photorealism? Repair via a follow-up edit turn, not a full regeneration.
STAGE 5 — DRAFT THEN PROMOTE Review at draft resolution, then promote the approved cut to delivery.

N-078_story_ad_three_frame.title: Story Ad: three five-second frames that hold the swipe
N-078_story_ad_three_frame.summary: INPUTS Product, character and world references plus the written brief.
N-078_story_ad_three_frame.pipeline: reference-image-input → character-input → background-input → prompt → 5× text-gen → 3× video-reference → video-concat → 2× text-gen → video-subtitle → download
notes: STAGE 1 — INPUTS Product, character and world references plus the written brief. Leave any input you do not need empty.
STAGE 2 — STRATEGY Turns a loose brief into a hard campaign spine: one job, one tension, one through-line device, locked look.
STAGE 3 — THE 15s SCRIPT Written as one continuous film that happens to be cut at the 5s and 10s marks — that is what makes the three clips join invisibly.
STAGE 4 — 3 x 5s CLIPS One writer and one generator per segment. Each writer reads the whole script and extracts only its own segment, carrying the handoff frame from its neighbour.
STAGE 5 — ASSEMBLY 3 clips concatenated in order into the finished 15-second film.
